text:
kevin_am: Galileo wants to migrate a POC from CompetitorOmega -> Redwood in two weeks. Their checklist: binding pricing for ~10M tokens/mo, exact header-preserve for legacy HMAC auth (X-GAL-HMAC), streaming framing compatibility (Omega uses netstring frames), deterministic JSON key ordering for a brittle downstream parser, stop-token trimming semantics, completed security questionnaire, per-request token logs for auditors, and a signed BAA. Can we run a quick preflight to list blockers?

mina_se: I can take pricing + streaming. Pricing: 10M fits our mid-tier; recommend a one-month promotional credit (30%) to help close. Streaming: CompetitorOmega uses netstring frames (length:data,comma). Our SSE/newline stream can be adapted by a small translator to emit netstrings server-side (frame_mode=omega_netstring). Will bench for per-chunk overhead (estimate 10-25ms).

alejandra_eng: Header passthrough: we drop cookies and patterns tagged as sensitive by default. We support a per-route whitelist preserve_headers=[...]. Need Galileo to provide the exact header list. If they require Authorization passthrough across tenants we need legal review. Also note: function-calling hooks must survive translation; confirm whether their client expects exact key ordering inside function args.

rob_sec: Quick security take: Data residency OK via Dedicated in eu-central or Private. Customer-managed KMS supported only on Private. Per-request logs exportable under NDA; retention and PII handling must be defined. BAA signing is standard for healthcare customers but adds a 5-7 day legal turnaround. I'll prepare initial questionnaire answers and flag CISO/legal items (KMS, raw-body retention, Authorization passthrough).

taylor_cs: Pinged Galileo for their filled security questionnaire, sample request/response pairs, and exact header names (they mentioned X-GAL-USER and X-GAL-HMAC). Asked them to redact secrets. They want our answers by Friday EOD and a sample invoice with per-route line items for auditors.

mina_se: On JSON parity and stop semantics: Omega strips the stop token and normalizes trailing whitespace and newlines; they also canonicalize top-level keys alphabetically which their parser requires. Options: (1) server-side compat flags stop_strip=true + canonicalize_json=alpha (top_level only), (2) client-side shim. For a POC, (1) route-level flags are fastest. Alejandra, can we scope canonicalize_json to top-level only so nested function-call args remain intact?

alejandra_eng: Yes, will implement canonicalize_json_scope=["top_level"] so we don't reorder inside function_call.args. Will add route params: {frame_mode:"omega_netstring", preserve_headers:["x-gal-user","x-gal-hmac"], stop_strip:true, canonicalize_json_scope:["top_level"]}. Will run a staging smoke.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging cluster rwd-presales-14 is available for smoke runs. Namespace "galileo-poc" provisioned; ephemeral creds created at 1778881300, expire in 48h. Recommended tests: 1) netstring stream smoke (20 prompts), 2) stop_strip + canonicalize_json top-level parity (50 prompts), 3) header passthrough verification. Logs will be stored at /var/presales/galileo for 48h. :rocket:

kevin_am: Galileo also asked about token rounding (they bill in 4-token buckets) and whether we can provide per-request tokenization evidence attached to invoices for audits. Finance wants to know if we should offer per-request logs or only aggregated route-level counts.

rob_sec: We can provide per-request token logs under NDA. If they require raw request body persistence, that's a CISO/legal item. For billing rounding we can match 4-token buckets on invoice generation and provide tokenizer samples. Will need to draft a data-export addendum for the NDA.

taylor_cs: Uploaded Galileo's questionnaire + sample traffic (redacted) to presales drive: https://redwood.app/drive/galileo/presales. They confirmed X-GAL-USER and X-GAL-HMAC and accept a 30% promo if we can meet framing/stop parity.

alejandra_eng: I'll push a small translator PR today implementing omega_netstring, stop_strip, and top-level key canonicalization. Will run the three smoke tests and post latency and logs here. ETA: tomorrow morning.

mina_se: If the smoke is green Omar (finance) can you prepare a sample invoice PDF showing 4-token rounding, per-route line items, and a note about per-request logs available under NDA?

kevin_am: I'll loop in finance and legal. Action items: Alejandra - translator PR + smoke logs. Rob - questionnaire draft + list legal gates. Taylor - confirm header list and collect any additional sample prompts. Mina - pricing proposal and propose promo. Finance/Legal - prepare invoice template + NDA/BAA path. Need smoke results by tomorrow 11:00 so I can send the POC SOW on Friday.

kevin_am: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the staging smoke. :thumbsup:
